messages:
Elena: Quick heads-up 1st & Harrison is basically an indoor-outdoor commute today dense fog + puddles. BART platform is packed because the elevator is out.
Tomas: Yikes. Im right by 2nd & Mission, leaving in 8. Can pick up one person on the way if youre near Market & 1st. DM me. :handshake:
Ravi: I left a clear rain poncho (XL) in locker #7 in the bike room labeled "commute rescue". Help yourselves.
commute-bot: BART alert: Elevator out of service at Embarcadero station; expect platform crowding. MUNI: Routes 8 and 14 experiencing delays due to low visibility.
Kai: Scooter battery died mid-puddle, now a small statue of a soggy commuter. Anyone have a portable charger / jumper for an e-scoot? :grimacing:
Zara: I have a tiny USB-C power bank in my desk drawer that might help for a quick boost. Dropping it at reception, name it "Zara - scooter boost".
front-desk: Reception note: we have an umbrella stash, a drying rack, and a labeled box for "short-term commuter gear" today. Please tag items with name & date if you leave them.
Elena: Also, the vending machine by the lobby decided to give out free packets of miso soup when I pressed C2 twice. If anyone needs warm liquid therapy, help yourself (its on me).
Leo: Miso soup hack = modern day heroism. Will bring spoons to the 9am standup. :tada:
Tomas: If standup is delayed, maybe we do an impromptu "commute karaoke" outside reception to keep spirits up? Low-key, 30 seconds each, weather permitting.
Ravi: Im in for karaoke as long as someone else sings something upbeat. Im no pro but I have a lot of enthusiasm.
Kai: Karaoke broken scooter ballad incoming. :microphone:
Zara: If youre stranded and want a quiet spot, 7th floor conference A is open until 9:15 for drips/towels/phone drying.
commute-bot: Facility reminder: commuter lockers available for temporary storage of wet gear. See facilities tab for access instructions.
Leo: Also, tiny PSA: if you borrow an umbrella from reception, please leave a sticky note with your name. Were trying to avoid the Great Umbrella Migration.
Elena: Thanks all  Tomas if you still have a seat and Kai needs a jump, Im two blocks from Market & 1st.
Tomas: Seat taken for one, leaving in 5. Kai DM me exact corner and Ill swing by.
Ravi: Let me know if anyone wants miso soup refills before 9:30. Im stocked.
Zara: Dropped the power bank at reception. Its labeled. Good luck, commute heroes. :sparkles:
Leo: Standup note: if folks are running late, shout in the channel. Otherwise, were on in 15. Karaoke optional but encouraged. :mic_drop:
